profile.headline: Full-stack Developer | Proud US Air Force Veteran | Python Enthusiast
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the leisure, travel & tourism industry.

Skilled in ReactJS, C-Sharp, SQL-Server, Python, Selenium,  and Data Visualization.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
● Reviewed code, debugged problems, and corrected issues.
● Employed coding practices based on commonly accepted standards to establish site layout and
user interface.
● Developed, implemented and optimized stored procedures and functions using T-SQL.
● Analyzed existing SQL queries to identify opportunities for improvements.
● Developed custom database objects, stored procedures, and delivered application support.
● Implemented the User Interface for Events using React.js and Bootstrap
● Developed back-end components to connect applications with web services.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
• Created and maintained information security documentation within departmental shared drive and SharePoint site.
• Designed, implemented, and incorporated user-defined functions within SQL database to allow queries to be more efficient.
• In cost/time prohibited situations utilized Excel as a provisional database.
• Performed back-ups and updates to systems with the most up-to-date Symitar software and technology.
• Sustained periodic training related to prevention and avoidance of malware, phishing, and fraud.
• Wrote edited and ran SQL queries.
• Translated Excel files and various business documents into SQL queries; allowing information to be easily updated and interpreted daily.
• Utilized visualization software to allow for expansive story-telling via imagery.
• Performed creation, deletion, and maintenance of user accounts and user access.
• Automated user account access within applicable systems.

positions.title: Senior Business Insight and Reporting Analyst
positions.description:
• Automated the process of extracting data from various websites using Python, Selenium, Selenium, and Webdriver.
• Worked intimately with internal teams, using data to drive continuous improvement in customer and company products.
• Expertly leveraged knowledge of Visual Basic for Applications to clean and manipulate required for daily reports, and repopulate cells containing complex formulas in the event of user error.
• Provided analysis on routine advertiser campaigns and their ROI; performed daily reporting of customer’s website activity using Google Analytics and Tableau.
• Designed, developed, and generated various dashboards in Tableau Desktop from multiple data sources.
• Prepared Dashboards using calculations, and parameters in Tableau Desktop.
• Extracted data daily from Tableau Desktop, and Tableau Server dashboards for reporting and analysis.
• Led team project to streamline the automation of reports incorporating Visual Basic for Applications and Python.
• Developed Tableau data visualization using Cross tabs, Scatter Plots, Pie Charts, and Bar Charts.
• Used Excel, Google Analytics, and Tableau to collect reports with large datasets to present to higher management, by incorporating Pivot tables, V-lookups, formulas, and dashboards.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Provided real-time and simulated support for Tyndall AFB, Gulf Range Drone Control System (GRDCS) unmanned and remote-control aircraft types.
• Monitored uplink and downlink RF telemetry communication systems for various aircraft types via electronic test equipment.
• Performed a limited scope data analysis for full-scale and subscale aircraft, through the use of software and hardware to extract and package relevant information for military customers. 
• Utilized Matlab to expand data quality tracking abilities of an existing program, improving the overall quality of communication that could be plotted for any mission occurring in the new location; while incorporating common coding standards, such as the DRY principle and comments to improve readability.
• Provided support for Aerial Targets Research Development and Testing exercises and system maintenance.
